reviewNotes:
IsctCompanion is an independent native client for students at Institute of Science Tokyo. It is not an official university app.

Architecture and school access: the app has no developer-operated application server or developer-issued account system. School requests go directly from the user's device to university services. University accounts and multi-factor authentication are issued and controlled by the university. We cannot create a dedicated university test account or provide another person's university credentials. No demo account or built-in demo mode is supplied in this build.

You can launch the app without a school account, dismiss the welcome sheet with Later, and inspect navigation and Settings. Retrieving personal classes, LMS materials and assignments, and sending files to an LMS assignment draft require a valid university account and its authentication factors. These school-linked features cannot be fully exercised without that account; the app does not bypass the university's authentication. School accounts are configured in Settings > School accounts.

Optional iCloud and Google Drive synchronization use the user's own cloud account. They do not require a developer-issued account.

The same iOS binary supports iPhone and iPad. On a wide iPad window, the app presents a sidebar and a wider course/assignment workspace. Please contact us if further review information is needed.

en-US.name: IsctCompanion
en-US.subtitle: Your Science Tokyo study day
en-US.description:
Keep your Science Tokyo study day in one place.

• See today's classes, upcoming exams and assignment deadlines.
• Browse courses, syllabi, materials and assignment details.
• Organize your timetable and personal study plans.
• Share files from other apps into an assignment workspace, then send them to the LMS draft area for review.
• Set reminders for classes, exams and assignments.
• Keep devices in sync with optional iCloud or Google Drive backups.
• Scan a Matrix card and manage automatic school verification codes.

On iPad, landscape view offers a wider workspace for course materials and assignments.

University-linked features use your own university account. IsctCompanion is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Institute of Science Tokyo.

ja.name: IsctCompanion
ja.subtitle: 科学大の授業・課題をひとつに
ja.description:
東京科学大学での学習を、ひとつの場所に。

・今日の授業、試験、課題の締め切りを確認
・授業、シラバス、教材、課題の詳細を閲覧
・時間割と学習計画を整理
・ほかのアプリから課題の作業スペースにファイルを共有し、LMS の下書き欄へ送って確認
・授業、試験、課題のリマインダーを設定
・iCloud や Google Drive を使った任意のバックアップと端末間同期
・マトリクス表の読み取りと大学の認証コードの管理

iPad の横向き表示では、広い作業スペースで教材や課題を扱えます。

大学のサービスと連携する機能には、ご自身の大学アカウントを使用します。IsctCompanion は独立したアプリであり、東京科学大学の公式アプリではありません。
ja.keywords: 科学大,時間割,課題,授業,シラバス,学習,試験,東京工業大学

zh-Hans.name: IsctCompanion
zh-Hans.subtitle: 科学大课表、课程与作业助手
zh-Hans.description:
把东京科学大学的日常学习安排放在一起。

• 查看今日课程、考试和作业截止时间
• 浏览课程、教学大纲、资料和作业详情
• 整理课表与个人学习计划
• 从其他 App 分享文件到作业工作区，再送入 LMS 草稿区确认
• 分别设置课程、考试和作业提醒
• 自选 iCloud、Google Drive 或两者，备份并同步多台设备
• 扫描 Matrix 卡，管理学校登录验证码

iPad 横屏提供更宽的工作区，方便查看课程资料和处理作业。

学校服务相关功能使用你自己的大学账号。IsctCompanion 是独立开发的应用，并非东京科学大学官方应用，也未获该大学背书。
zh-Hans.keywords: 科学大,课表,作业,课程,考试,学习计划,东京工业大学
